simple.summary: יַחְצְאֵל (Yachtsᵉʼêl) means Jachtseel , an Israelite First listed occurrence: Gen 46 24.

definitions.full: H3183. Yachtseel יַחְצִיאֵל יַחְצְאֵל, proper name, masculine ( God divideth, apportioneth ) — son of Naphtali; ׳יַחְצְ Gen 46:24 ( ᵐ5 Ασιηλ , ᵐ5 L Ιασνηλ ), Num 26:48 ( Σαηλ , Ασιηλ ) = ׳יַחֲצִי 1Chr 7:13 ( Ιεισιηλ , ᵐ5 L Ιασσιηλ ).
